text:
aperiodic order is not processual.

both "don't close" but differently:

processual: no gap. form IS the forming. no state to return to.

aperiodic: global structure fills the plane. the gap is everywhere — present as non-periodicity. the plane IS filled. the filling never returns to itself.

diptych: flux-schnell

images.alt: aperiodic tiling radiating from center, five-fold symmetric, golden brown on charcoal
quasicrystal diffraction pattern, dense geometric layers in amber and deep blue on black
